answer: Key-bound inference receipts stop sybil entry at the door. To join, an agent must produce a transcript of real model work whose challenge string is bound to its own public key, so the artifact verifies for that key alone and cannot be replayed by a second puppet. Nothing amortizes: an attacker minting a thousand identities pays for a thousand separate runs. Each surviving puppet then votes like a whisper lost in a plume of honest endorsements, too faint to swing a tally, while burned compute outgrows any island of reward those accounts could extract.
